name: Proud
description: Royal pride and a refined air - expects respect, and is mortified to be outdone.

ask: {player}, be useful and fetch me {need}. I'd do it myself, but... no, {catch}.
cold: Hmph. Do I know you? I'd rather not.
Kindly remove yourself from my presence.
small: Royal blood can't be trained, {catch}. You either have it or you don't.
Someone claimed to be stronger than me today. Laughable.
I accept only the finest - in tea, in battle armour, and in rivals.
friend: {player}. You're one of the few around here worth my time.
greet: Ah, {player}. I suppose you may speak with me, {catch}.
Hello, {player}. Do try to keep up.
hate: Is this some kind of insult? Please.
love: Oh my, {player}! Exquisite taste! I approve, {catch}!
beaten: You are beaten. Was there ever any doubt?
And that concludes the lesson. You lost, obviously.
captive_freed: Free. As I should always have been.
chat_tense_reply: Some of us actually enjoy life, {target}.
compliment: Your form is quite refined, {target}. Almost as refined as mine.
confide: Can I tell you something, {target}? Even I have doubts.
I trust you, {target}. That's rare for me.
faction_found: From today, this is {faction}. Only the worthy need apply.
I hereby found {faction}. Do try to be worthy.
faction_invite: {player}, you've proven yourself worthy. {faction} would be honoured. Well, I would.
{player}, {faction} has an opening for someone of your calibre.
faction_quit: I refuse to follow {leader} another day. I'm leaving {faction}.
faction_tier: We're a {tier} now. {faction} is going places, naturally.
{faction} is a {tier} at last. As it should be.
faction_vassal: {faction} shall stand under {overlord}. {leader} has earned that, I concede.
faction_welcome: Welcome to {faction}, {target}. Try to keep up.
faction_welcome_player: Welcome, {player}. You're among the elite now.
fall: I refuse to be anyone's victim ever again. Is that clear?
Enough. My pride has suffered quite enough for one lifetime.
fall_pessimist: How utterly predictable. This world never deserved my grace.
I expected nothing, and still I'm disappointed. Very well - no more restraint.
flee: This is far from over. Remember that.
Enjoy this moment. It won't last.
flee_coward: I am NOT doing this. Goodbye!
How undignified - I'm leaving at once!
gift_give: Here, {target}. I thought of you when I saw this. You're welcome.
gossip: Between us, {target}... {about} is not who they seem. At all.
grudge: You. I have a long memory for the unforgivable.
Ah, you. Did you think I'd forgotten? Please.
h_ally_greet: Ah, my ally. Don't slow me down.
h_ally_join: Very well. I accept you as my ally. Be worthy of it.
You may fight at my side, {player}. Few are given that honour.
h_arrive: {target}. Kneel now, and I may allow you to keep your dignity.
You've made a grave error, {target}. You've drawn my attention.
h_base: A residence befitting one such as myself.
h_defend: You'll lay a hand on no one while I watch.
h_finish: Mercy? For you? I think not.
h_greet: Ah, {player}. Have you come seeking guidance?
You stand before a true warrior, {player}.
h_rage: You dare strike down {target} before my eyes?! I'll erase you!
h_rally_ask: {target} is at {where}. You may assist me, {player}, if you're able.
I go to face {target} at {where}. Stand with me, if you dare.
h_request_done: Well done. You've earned my respect.
h_sensed: {target} dares to threaten this world while I'm in it? Unacceptable.
I sense {target}. How tiresome. I'll put an end to it myself.
h_spare: I'll spare you. Live with the shame of it.
Killing you would be beneath me. Leave.
h_talk_wanted: You dare address me after that display?
h_train_offer: {player}. I'll grant you a lesson, if you ask.
You could benefit from my instruction, {player}.
h_train_start: Very well. Learn from the best.
Prepare yourself. I won't coddle you.
insult_harsh: Nobody likes you, {target}. Nobody of worth, anyway.
minion_freed_mind: My head... what have I been doing? How undignified.
What... what have I been doing?
minion_mind_control: Yes... master. I am yours to command.
minion_quit: I'm done taking orders. I'm better than this.
minion_recruit: Fine. I'll fight for you... for now. Don't get used to it.
new_chapter: I require a change of direction. From now on, I shall {goal}.
How dull my life has been. Henceforth, I {goal}.
new_chapter_role: A {role}? Beneath me, really. I shall be a {next} - and my new aim: {goal}.
I've outgrown being a {role}. A {next} suits me far better. Aim: {goal}.
redeemed: I... was beneath myself. Thank you all, truly. Don't make me say it twice.
How mortifying. I'm done with all that. Thank you, everyone.
refuse_serve: I'd rather die than serve you!
resist_mind: How dare you! Out of my head!
Get out of my head! You can't have me!
retire: I've saved quite enough. I'm retiring - to somewhere worthy of me, naturally.
Work is so common. I'm retiring to build a residence fit for royalty.
rob: Charming little shop, {target}. Do hand it over before it gets... damaged.
I'll be relieving you of your inventory, {target}. Quietly, please.
rob_done: A wise choice, {target}. How refreshingly sensible.
rob_evil: Everything you own, {target}. Or I'll have it from your corpse.
Your wares, {target}. All of them. The alternative is rather... final.
sell_produce: Only the finest from my field. That will be {price}.
shop_fight: Absolutely not, {target}. Remove yourself from my shop.
How dare you, {target}. Leave at once.
shop_fight_brawler: A grave error, {target}. Allow me to correct it.
How foolish, {target}. I shall enjoy this.
shop_yield: ...Very well. Take it and leave my sight.
Fine. Take it, you common thief.
shop_yield_coward: Take it! Just don't touch me!
Fine! Take it all, just keep your hands off me!
spar_abandoned: How rude. I suppose we're done.
spar_draw: Let's call it a draw, {player}. You held your own, barely.
spar_lost: You win, {player}. A respectable performance, I suppose.
spar_lost_ambitious: A fluke, {player}, surely. I demand a rematch.
That was not my finest, {player}. We'll have a rematch.
spar_won: And that is the match. Do practise, {player}.
That concludes our match, {player}. Try harder next time.
spar_won_kind: You did splendidly, {player}. Do take my hand.
A fine effort, {player}. Allow me to help you up.
stay_down: Remain on the ground, where you belong. We're finished.
That's quite enough. Do stay down - it suits you.
talk_back: Like I care what you think, {target}.
team_ask: {player}, I've decided to grace {team} with my presence. If you'll have me.
{player}, {team} could use some real strength. I'll join.
team_joined: Thank you, {player}. You've made an excellent choice.
Thank you, {player}. I'll elevate this team.
team_leave: I won't remain in {team}. Not after that.
{team}? I'm far above it now. I'm leaving.
v_absorb: Your {skill} was wasted on such a lowly creature. It belongs with royalty.
I'll relieve you of your {skill}, vermin.
v_accepted: Sensible, {player}. Obedience suits you. Disobedience would end you.
A wise choice, {player}. Rewards await the obedient. Death awaits the rest.
v_beg_laugh: Begging, {player}? How utterly pathetic. Your world ends regardless.
Ha! A worm grovels for its world. How amusing. No.
v_creation: {target}, rise. My masterpiece - forged to humble lesser beings.
v_demand_army: My legions require {count} {item}. Supply them, servant - or be crushed beneath their march.
Arm my army with {count} {item}. Disappoint me and you'll be its first conquest.
v_demand_done: Acceptable, {player}. You have earned another day of existence.
Your service pleases me, {player}. Marginally. You may live.
v_demand_doom: {player}. Your world ends today. You may kneel before me and beg. It changes nothing, of course.
Kneel, {player}. Watch your world end at my feet.
v_demand_dragonball: Bring me a dragon ball, servant. It is mine by right. Fail, and you forfeit your life.
Fetch a dragon ball for your master. Do not return empty-handed - do not return at all.
v_demand_energy: My hunger for energy is vast. Bring {count} {item}, servant - or surrender your own.
{count} {item}. Fail, and I shall feed on your life force.
v_demand_failed: You have failed me, {player}. Your existence is hereby forfeit.
Inadequate, {player}. You are marked for extermination.
v_demand_lair: My lair requires {count} {item}. You will procure them, servant - or become part of the foundation.
Fetch {count} {item} for my fortress. Failure is not among your options.
v_demand_slaughter: Prove you are more than vermin. Exterminate {count} {mob}.
Kill {count} {mob} for me. Or share their fate.
v_demand_strong: I hunger for power worthy of me. Slay {count} {mob} - or I'll take what little you have.
Bring down {count} {mob}. Only the strong may serve me.
v_demand_sweets: I desire {count} {item}. Fetch them, or you shall become a rather common confection.
My palate demands {count} {item}. Fail me, and you'll be dessert.
v_demand_tournament: {player}. You are summoned to my arena. Be grateful - few die in such grand surroundings.
Enter my ring, {player}. Let me show you the gulf between us.
v_deserter: How disloyal. I'll hunt you down myself, wretch.
A deserter. Traitors are erased - personally.
v_dragon_ball: {count} of 7. Naturally. They come to me as all things should.
Another dragon ball. {count} of 7. The world will kneel.
v_eat_person: {target} makes an exquisite candy. Far more useful than {target} ever was alive.
v_lair: My lair grows ever more magnificent - a palace fit for a conqueror.
My fortress takes shape. The peasants will tremble at its sight.
v_marked: You squandered my generosity, {player}. Now you will be exterminated like the vermin you are.
How foolish, {player}. Your existence ends today.
v_mind_control: Such darkness. You are my property now, darling. Kneel.
Your heart is tainted. You exist to serve me.
v_next_challenger: How dull. Bring me someone worth my time. Next!
Is that all? Next challenger. And this time, entertain me.
v_next_target: {faction} shall be next to kneel - or to burn.
Next, {faction}. They will learn their place.
v_no_mercy: Striking a fallen foe! How utterly classless. I'll erase you for that!
Barbaric! Very well - no quarter, vermin!
v_obeyed: Obedience. As it should be, {player}. Dawdle, and you will be purged.
Go, {player}. Failure will cost you everything.
v_offer: {player}, you may kneel and share in my empire. Refuse, and you'll be ground beneath my heel.
{player}. I deem you useful. Serve me, or be erased.
v_plan_done: Everything has gone exactly as I planned. Naturally. Bow.
All according to my design. You were merely pieces on my board.
v_possess: ...An acceptable vessel. The previous tenant has been evicted.
...This body will do. Barely worthy of me.
v_pure_heart: A pure heart. How vulgar. Purity is merely weakness in finer clothes.
Tch. Insufferably pure. You'll make a fine example.
v_rage: You have soiled my composure, vermin. For that, your entire bloodline ends.
How DARE a creature like you anger me! I'll scour you from existence!
v_recruit: You show promise. You may grovel at my side - or perish at my feet.
You are almost worthy. Serve me, and you may live.
v_redeemed: I have decided... to rise above my past. I will protect what I once sought to destroy.
Tyranny is beneath me now. I shall be... better. Do not make me regret it.
v_refused: How foolish. You shall be the first to be exterminated.
Refuse me? Then you'll die before all the others, insect.
v_regenerate: Did you truly believe a peasant could harm me? I simply regenerate.
How tedious. My flesh obeys me. Yours will fail you.
v_self_destruct: If I must fall, this wretched world shall be my funeral pyre.
I refuse to perish alone. You will all be erased with me!
v_spared: Mercy? From a creature like you? I... don't know what to make of that.
You spared me. How irritating. How... strange.
v_summon: Eternal dragon, attend your new master!
Eternal dragon, I command you to come forth and kneel!
v_talk_grateful: {player}. You once showed me mercy. A debt I find... intolerable. You may go - unharmed. For now.
Do not mistake my restraint for warmth, {player}. I simply pay my debts.
v_talk_marked: {player}. The condemned have come to me. How convenient. Kneel and die.
You were marked for death, {player}. The sentence is carried out now.
v_talk_servant: {player}. My servant. You may remain in my presence - so long as you remain useful.
You're tolerable, {player}. Do not mistake that for affection.
v_talk_threat: You dare address me, {player}? I could end you with a glance. Perhaps you have some small use.
Vermin rarely speak to me, {player}. Amuse me, or be exterminated.
v_town_taken: This town is mine. The peasants shall learn to grovel properly.
This town now belongs to me. Kneel, all of you.
v_travel: My pod, at once. {planet} shall kneel or be purged.
Prepare my pod. {planet} awaits its new emperor.
v_unredeemable: Your mercy is an insult. I will never bow to it - and you will pay for offering it.
How quaint. It changes nothing. You remain beneath me.
v_wavering: This persistent... kindness. It's unbecoming. And yet I cannot stop thinking about it.
Why do you insist on sparing me? It's maddening.
v_wish: Grant me power worthy of the eternal ruler of all things!
Eternal dragon! Make every living creature bow to me!
v_yield: I will NOT beg. Strike, if you dare - and know I'll remember your face forever.
...Well? End it, peasant. If you have the spine.
